About Margin

Margin is a podcast player for people who listen a lot and want to stay in charge of it. It has per-show speed and skip settings, silence trimming, an Inbox for new episodes, multiple queues, chapters, transcripts, and stats about how you listen. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Common Questions

Do I need an account?

No. Margin has no sign-in at all.

How do I add a show?

Search for it by name, or paste a feed link (an RSS address) to add any show directly. You can also paste a Spotify show link and Margin will look for the matching show in Apple's podcast directory.

How do I bring my shows from another podcast app?

Use Settings → Import OPML and pick the OPML file you exported from your old app. Your shows are added in one go.

How do transcripts work?

If a show provides a transcript in its feed, Margin shows it. Otherwise Margin can make one on your iPhone using Apple's on-device speech recognition; your audio never leaves your device. You can search a transcript, jump to any line, and share a quote. Machine-made transcripts can contain mistakes.

What is the shared transcript cache, and can I turn it off?

To save other listeners from repeating the work, Margin can look up and share transcript text for public episodes, keyed by a one-way hash of the episode. No audio, account or device identifier is involved. To turn it off, go to Settings → Transcripts → Shared transcript cache. Details are in the privacy policy.

Do my shows and progress sync between my devices?

Optionally. Turn on iCloud sync and your library, progress and queues sync through your own private iCloud database, with both devices signed in to the same Apple Account. Nothing goes to a server we run. Turn it off and Margin keeps everything on that one device.

My library isn't syncing.

Confirm both devices are signed in to the same Apple Account, that iCloud is enabled for Margin under iOS Settings → [your name] → iCloud, and that sync is turned on inside Margin. Sync happens in the background, so give it a minute on a good connection.

Does Margin work with CarPlay, Apple Watch and widgets?

Yes. Margin supports CarPlay, has an Apple Watch app, and offers Home Screen widgets. It also works with Siri and Shortcuts. To add a widget, press and hold the Home Screen, tap the plus button and choose Margin.

How do I export my data?

Settings → Export OPML saves your list of shows, and Settings → Export listening data saves your listening data. Both are files you can save anywhere. We never receive them.

How do I get new episodes without losing track of them?

New episodes land in your Inbox. From there you can queue them, save them for later, or clear them. You can also set a show to auto-download its latest 1, 2, 5, 10 or all episodes.
